newsitem.title: USA: Cisco Systems expands product line.
newsitem.headline: Cisco Systems expands product line.

text.p: Cisco Systems Inc said Friday it had expanded its offerings by adding two new models of its Cisco Catalyst 5000 series.
One of the new models, the Cisco Catalyst 5002, will help customers speed up data transmission through departmental networks and improve its workgroup functionality.

The other model, Cisco Catalyst 5500, is a switching platform that incorporates the architectures of the Catalyst 5000 family and Asynchronous Transfer Mode (ATM) cell switching capabilities into a single chassis, the company said.
Cisco also said it introduced a suite of software products for its expanded series of Catalyst 5000 switches meant to upgrade network services to corporate Intranets.

The networking company said it is shipping its Catalyst 5000 software Release 2.2 with all its other Catalyst 5000 series products. CWSI Release 1.3 for UNIX is available now for $7995 and for NT it is available for $6995, Cisco said.
